exposure: Both endometriotic nodules and ovarian endometriomas
outcome: Prevalence of deep and/or ovarian endometriosis
Association of endometriosis with demographic characteristics and pelvic abnormalities
cohort: 1026 premenopausal women attending a general gynecology clinic
finding: Deep and/or ovarian endometriosis was present in nearly one in five women attending a general gynecology clinic, with significant positive associations with adenomyosis and pelvic adhesions and negative associations with higher parity and previous Cesarean section.
mod_finding: This study found a negative association between endometriosis and history of Cesarean section.
